_doc: Every page and API route that the middleware matcher does NOT gate, with the reason it may be reached without a session. A new route outside the matcher fails src/routeInventory.test.ts until it is listed here (ADR 0037). Public pages must hold no tenant data.

/.reason: Static front page: copy and links, reads nothing from the database.

/privacy.reason: Notice text and the organisation's published notice fields only; the request form writes one row for the engagement's organisation and reads nothing.

/login.reason: Sign-in form; throttled, no tenant data.

/quiz.reason: Demo quiz. No tenant, nothing stored.

/quiz/result.reason: Mascot reveal from the tier in the URL; no tenant, no database read.

/api/locale/init.reason: Stores the engagement language in a cookie for a first visit, then redirects to a /s/<token> path; reads nothing.

/api/auth/open.reason: Spends a single-use, expiring 'Open my space' token and sets the referent session cookie; reads no tenant data and shows none.

/s/[token].reason: Signed invitation token fixes tenant and pseudonym; respondent sees only their own state.

/s/open/[slug].reason: Public team address: creates one anonymous invitation for this browser (httpOnly cookie) and redirects to its signed token; reads and shows no tenant data.

/s/[token]/done.reason: Signed invitation token; own state only.

/s/[token]/quiz.reason: Signed invitation token; tenant and pseudonym come from it.

/api/answer.reason: Verifies the invitation token before any write.

/api/progress.reason: Your path of the signed-in account (ADR 0056): the handler checks the session itself; signed out gets 401; it stores lesson and step flags only, never an answer.

/api/send.reason: Front-page send step (ADR 0055): the handler checks the session itself; signed out gets 401 and nothing is written; the team comes from the session only.

/api/skip.reason: Verifies the invitation token before any write.

/api/submit.reason: Verifies the invitation token before submitting; idempotent.

/api/locale.reason: Verifies the invitation token; changes only that respondent's locale.

/api/auth/login.reason: Credential check, throttled; returns no tenant data.

/api/admin/invitations.reason: Route handler checks the session and tenant membership itself; bare 403 otherwise.

/api/view-as.reason: Route handler checks the session (platform owner only) itself.

/set-password.reason: Single-use link token checked on the server; shows no tenant data, never says which account.

/forgot-password.reason: Asks for an email address; same answer for every address, rate limited, no tenant data.

/learn.reason: Redirect to the front page Learn (TASK-AI L2); no data.

/learn/how.reason: Redirect to the front page Learn (TASK-AI L2); no data.

/learn/questions.reason: Redirect to the front page Learn (TASK-AI L2); no data.

/learn/results.reason: Redirect to the front page Learn (TASK-AI L2); no data.

/learn/videos.reason: Redirect to the front page Learn (TASK-AI L2); no data.
